troponin-t.intended_use: Detection of cardiac troponin T for myocardial injury assessment.
troponin-t.clinical_context: Cardiac troponin T (cTnT) is a myocardial-specific biomarker; with troponin I, one of the two troponin isoforms used in acute MI diagnosis.
troponin-t.limitations: Qualitative POC assay is triage-grade; high-sensitivity quantitative assays and serial testing are the clinical standard.
troponin-t.procurement: Specimen: WB/S/P. Format: cassette. CE-marked line.

h-fabp.intended_use: Detection of heart-type fatty acid binding protein for early myocardial injury.
h-fabp.clinical_context: H-FABP rises early after myocardial injury and is used as an early marker in some cardiac panels.
h-fabp.limitations: Not a standalone diagnostic; use with troponin and clinical context.
h-fabp.procurement: Specimen: WB/S/P. Format: cassette, 25 T. CE-marked line.

pct.intended_use: Detection of procalcitonin (PCT) for bacterial infection/sepsis risk assessment.
pct.clinical_context: PCT rises in systemic bacterial infection and sepsis; supports antibiotic-stewardship decisions.
pct.limitations: Semi-quantitative POC results are triage-grade; interpret with clinical context.
pct.procurement: Specimen: WB/S/P. Format: cassette. CE-marked line.

saa.intended_use: Detection of serum amyloid A (SAA) for inflammation.
saa.clinical_context: SAA is an acute-phase protein; used alongside CRP in infection/inflammation triage.
saa.procurement: Specimen: WB/S/P. Format: cassette. CE-marked line.

cea.intended_use: Detection of carcinoembryonic antigen (CEA) for colorectal cancer monitoring support.
cea.clinical_context: CEA is a tumor marker used in colorectal cancer monitoring and, with other markers, in screening support.
cea.limitations: Not diagnostic alone; elevated in benign conditions and smoking. Imaging/confirmatory testing required.
cea.procurement: Specimen: WB/S/P. Format: cassette. CE-marked line.

fsh.intended_use: Detection of follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH) for menopause/fertility assessment.
fsh.clinical_context: Elevated FSH indicates reduced ovarian reserve / menopause; used in fertility evaluation.
fsh.limitations: Interpret with age and clinical context; not a standalone diagnosis.
fsh.procurement: Specimen: urine. Format: dipstick / device. CE-marked line.

ffn.intended_use: Detection of fetal fibronectin (fFN) in cervicovaginal secretion for preterm birth risk.
ffn.clinical_context: fFN is used to stratify preterm delivery risk in symptomatic pregnant women.
ffn.limitations: Risk-stratification aid, not diagnostic; interpret with gestational age and clinical findings.
ffn.procurement: Specimen: vaginal secretion. Format: device / strip. CE-marked line.

igfbp-1.intended_use: Detection of IGFBP-1 in vaginal secretion for preterm birth risk.
igfbp-1.clinical_context: Phosphorylated IGFBP-1 is a marker of cervical ripening; used for preterm delivery risk assessment.
igfbp-1.procurement: Specimen: vaginal secretion. Format: device / strip. CE-marked line.

hpv-16-18.intended_use: Detection of HPV 16/18 antigen for high-risk HPV screening support.
hpv-16-18.clinical_context: HPV 16 and 18 cause the majority of cervical cancers; genotyping supports risk stratification.
hpv-16-18.limitations: POC antigen detection is screening-grade; confirm with molecular (PCR) genotyping.
hpv-16-18.procurement: Specimen: cervical swab. Format: device. CE-marked line.

chikungunya.clinical_context: Chikungunya is a mosquito-borne alphavirus; serology supports diagnosis in endemic regions.
chikungunya.limitations: Cross-reactivity with dengue possible; confirm with molecular where available.
chikungunya.procurement: Specimen: WB/S/P. Format: cassette. CE-marked line.

zika.clinical_context: Zika is a mosquito-borne flavivirus; antigen/serology support diagnosis, especially in pregnancy risk assessment.
zika.limitations: Strong dengue cross-reactivity in serology; interpret with travel/exposure history.
zika.procurement: Specimen: WB/S/P. Format: cassette. CE-marked line.

leptospira.clinical_context: Leptospirosis is a zoonotic bacterial infection; serology supports diagnosis.
leptospira.limitations: Serology has timing and cross-reactivity limitations; confirm with reference methods.
leptospira.procurement: Specimen: WB/S/P. Format: cassette. CE-marked line.

leishmania.clinical_context: Leishmaniasis is a parasitic infection; serology supports diagnosis in endemic areas.
leishmania.limitations: Serology is supportive; parasitological/molecular confirmation preferred.
leishmania.procurement: Specimen: WB/S/P. Format: cassette. CE-marked line.

typhoid.intended_use: Detection of Salmonella Typhi IgG/IgM antibodies or antigen.
typhoid.clinical_context: Typhoid fever serology/antigen supports diagnosis where blood culture is unavailable.
typhoid.limitations: Serology has sensitivity/specificity limits; culture is the reference.
typhoid.procurement: Specimen: WB/S/P (Ab) / feces (Ag). Format: cassette / dipstick. CE-marked line.

cholera-o1-o139.intended_use: Detection of Vibrio cholerae O1/O139 antigen in feces.
cholera-o1-o139.clinical_context: Cholera antigen detection supports outbreak screening and rapid diagnosis.
cholera-o1-o139.procurement: Specimen: feces. Format: cassette. CE-marked line.

tb-igg-igm.clinical_context: TB serology is a screening aid in resource-limited settings.
tb-igg-igm.limitations: Serology is not recommended as a standalone TB diagnostic (WHO); culture/molecular remain reference.
tb-igg-igm.procurement: Specimen: WB/S/P. Format: dipstick / cassette. CE-marked line.

mycoplasma.intended_use: Detection of Mycoplasma pneumoniae IgM/IgG or antigen.
mycoplasma.clinical_context: M. pneumoniae is a common cause of atypical pneumonia; IgM/antigen support diagnosis.
mycoplasma.limitations: Serology timing affects sensitivity; molecular confirmation where needed.
mycoplasma.procurement: Specimen: WB/S/P (serology) / swab (antigen). Format: cassette. CE-marked line.

doa-mtd.clinical_context: Methadone screening in opioid treatment programs and workplace testing; cut-off 300 ng/mL.
doa-mtd.procurement: Specimen: urine. Format: cassette / dipstick. CE-marked line.

doa-fentanyl.clinical_context: Fentanyl screening for the synthetic-opioid crisis; cut-offs 20–200 ng/mL.
doa-fentanyl.procurement: Specimen: urine. Format: cassette / dipstick. CE-marked line.

doa-ketamine.procurement: Specimen: urine. Format: cassette / dipstick. CE-marked line.

doa-xylazine.clinical_context: Xylazine (veterinary sedative) is an emerging adulterant in the illicit opioid supply.
doa-xylazine.procurement: Specimen: urine. Format: cassette / dipstick. CE-marked line.

fob.intended_use: Detection of fecal occult blood (FOB) for colorectal screening.
fob.clinical_context: FOB testing supports colorectal cancer screening programs.
fob.limitations: Positive FOB requires colonoscopy follow-up; dietary/interference caveats apply.
fob.procurement: Specimen: feces. Format: device / strip. CE-marked line.

ferritin.intended_use: Detection of ferritin for iron status.
ferritin.clinical_context: Ferritin reflects iron stores; low ferritin indicates iron deficiency.
ferritin.limitations: Ferritin is an acute-phase reactant — elevated in inflammation independent of iron status.
ferritin.procurement: Specimen: WB/S/P. Format: cassette. CE-marked line.

calprotectin.intended_use: Detection of fecal calprotectin for intestinal inflammation.
calprotectin.clinical_context: Calprotectin distinguishes inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) from functional disorders (IBS).
calprotectin.limitations: Screening aid — not diagnostic; elevated in other gut inflammation.
calprotectin.procurement: Specimen: feces. Format: cassette. CE-marked line.

lactoferrin.intended_use: Detection of fecal lactoferrin for intestinal inflammation.
lactoferrin.clinical_context: Lactoferrin is a fecal marker of intestinal inflammation, used alongside calprotectin.
lactoferrin.procurement: Specimen: feces. Format: cassette. CE-marked line.

hba1c.intended_use: Detection of glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c) for diabetes.
hba1c.clinical_context: HbA1c reflects average blood glucose over ~2–3 months; used in diabetes diagnosis and monitoring.
hba1c.limitations: POC semi-quantitative HbA1c is screening-grade; lab HbA1c is the reference.
hba1c.procurement: Specimen: whole blood. Format: cassette / strip. CE-marked line.

vitamin-d.intended_use: Detection of 25-OH Vitamin D for deficiency screening.
vitamin-d.clinical_context: Vitamin D deficiency screening; semi-quantitative POC assay.
vitamin-d.limitations: Screening-grade; quantitative lab assay is the reference.
vitamin-d.procurement: Specimen: whole blood. Format: cassette. CE-marked line.

tsh.intended_use: Detection of thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH) for thyroid screening.
tsh.clinical_context: TSH is the first-line thyroid function test.
tsh.limitations: POC qualitative TSH is screening-grade; quantitative lab TSH is reference.
tsh.procurement: Specimen: WB/S/P. Format: cassette. CE-marked line.

total-ige.intended_use: Detection of total IgE for allergy screening.
total-ige.limitations: Non-specific — elevated in parasitic infection and other conditions; specific IgE tests are more informative.
total-ige.procurement: Specimen: WB/S/P. Format: cassette / strip. CE-marked line.

chagas.intended_use: Detection of Trypanosoma cruzi antibodies for Chagas disease.
chagas.clinical_context: Chagas is a parasitic infection endemic to Latin America; serology supports diagnosis.
chagas.limitations: Confirmatory testing recommended per regional algorithms.
chagas.procurement: Specimen: WB/S/P. Format: cassette. CE-marked line.

filariasis.clinical_context: Filariasis (lymphatic filariasis) serology supports diagnosis in endemic regions.
filariasis.limitations: Serology cross-reactivity with other helminths possible.
filariasis.procurement: Specimen: WB/S/P. Format: cassette. CE-marked line.
